placements.name: Portfolio Shrine
placements.description: A mystical monument that seems to reflect your very presence. How... recursive.

placements.name: The Bard's Hollow
placements.description: Square waves and triangle tones drift across the meadow. An eight-bit songbird nests here, chirping in perfect 60Hz time.

placements.name: The Automaton Forge
placements.description: Gears turn in perfect synchrony, each cog knowing its place. The machines here tend to themselves, an endless dance of configuration.

placements.name: The Creator's Archive
placements.description: The townspeople whisper that the creator himself once resided here. Within these walls, his deeds and knowledge are preserved for eternity.

placements.name: The Compiler Forge
placements.description: Ancient runes are carved into the walls. They speak of transformations... of text becoming power.

placements.name: Parser's Cabin
placements.description: A humble dwelling where symbols are weighed and balanced. The chimney smoke forms strange equations.

placements.name: The Disassembly Workshop
placements.description: Gears and mechanisms lie exposed. Here, the inner workings of serpentine magic are revealed.

placements.name: The Presentation Stage
placements.description: Slides materialize from thin air, arranged by an unseen conductor. The show must go on!

placements.name: The Vault Library
placements.description: Endless shelves of interlinked tomes, each note a thread to a dozen others. Scholars swear the library rearranges itself to reveal what you seek.

placements.name: The Statistics Bureau
placements.description: Numbers float through the air like fireflies. Every action counted, every moment measured.

placements.name: The Harbormaster's Office
placements.description: Ledgers track every vessel in the fleet, each cargo mirrored across distant ports. Nothing leaves the harbor out of sync.

placements.name: The Academy
placements.description: Young minds gather here, eyes bright with curiosity. The chalkboard never stays clean for long.

placements.name: The Conjuring Classroom
placements.description: Students summon a fully-formed Java golem from empty air, no scrolls to fetch nor downloads to await. The lesson begins at once.

placements.name: Block Tower
placements.description: Colorful shapes fall from the heavens, demanding order. A tribute to grandfathers everywhere.

placements.name: Naval Quarters
placements.description: Model ships line the shelves. Somewhere, cannons thunder across imaginary waters.

placements.name: The Art Studio
placements.description: Brushes hover in mid-air, leaving trails of color. Creation needs no hands here.

placements.name: Navigator's Hut
placements.description: Maps upon maps, portals to distant realms. The world wide web of roads converges here.

placements.name: The Medical Tower
placements.description: White walls gleam with purpose. Within, the chronicles of health are written in meticulous detail.
